posts.author: Dinesh
posts.content_md:
[quote:38355078a1]I think I remember hearing Dinesh and Colin saying something about "free beer" for all those who attend. Allthough I could be wrong about that.... [/quote:38355078a1]

Well, therein lies a tale. Among Colin's many accomplishments he happens to be a world class brewer. A while back he taught me to make beer which was so good that people who normally didn't like beer were gulping it down! I expected the 7 odd gallons to last me several months but it was all gone in about a month. In the beginning, everyone kept saying, "You made this? You!!" Jeez! You'd think Physicists couldn't make beer! Well, I started off trying to explain that a brewmaster friend had mostly made it while I watched, but unfortunately they were enjoying the beer too much to take account of the explanation. So, in the end, I just swallowed the guilt and said, "Yeah, I made it" So I figure that I owe to myself to really make it all by meself. I also figured I'd wait for PCG as a sort of homage to my beer tutor. One thing beer making needs is time. I need about 3 weeks of advance notice. Since several people have committed to coming, The Beer Shall Flow!
